title: Creamy Malaysian Rice Pudding
description: A delicious and comforting dessert made with creamy velvety pudding, malaysian rice, and a touch of sweetness. Perfect for a gluten-free treat.
instructions: Combine the malaysian rice, sugar, and salt in a medium saucepan.
Add the coconut milk and vanilla extract, and stir to combine.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the mixture has thickened.
Stir in the velvety pudding until well combined.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the pudding has melted and the mixture is smooth.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
